hero_tagline: The ultimate invisible barrier against road hazards and rock chips, engineered with PPF's advanced self-healing technology.
anatomy_subtitle: Flexible and durable thermoplastic urethane designed to absorb road impact and protect your vehicle's most vulnerable surfaces.

anatomy_layers.title: Self-Healing Top Coat
anatomy_layers.desc: Elastomeric polymers automatically heal surface scratches when exposed to sun or heat.

anatomy_layers.title: PPF Impact Core
anatomy_layers.desc: Absorbs energy from sand, flying gravel, and insects, preventing them from reaching the original paint.

anatomy_layers.title: Non-Yellowing Nano-Adhesive
anatomy_layers.desc: Strong bonding agent that prevents edge peeling and is unaffected by heat, preserving vehicle paint.

visual_subtitle: See the aesthetic difference between crystal-clear Glossy finish and elegant Matte finish.

packages.name: PPF Front-End Protection
packages.note: (Includes bumper, fenders, hood, mirrors, and headlights - 5-year warranty)
features: Full coverage of front areas most exposed to highway rock chips
Heat-activated self-healing technology for surface scratches
Excellent crystal clarity that preserves original paint color
High resistance to UV rays and film yellowing

packages.name: PPF Full-Body Protection
features: 100% full coverage of all exterior painted car parts
Choices between crystal Glossy finish or premium Matte finish
Ultimate resistance against scratches, light impacts, and bird droppings
Hydrophobic and dust-repellent technology for easier washing
